test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In the wake of the Andhra Pradesh microfinance crisis of 2010, RBI had constituted which committee to study issues and concerns in the Microfinance Institutions sector in India?
solution:
The correct answer is **Malegam Committee.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The committee was set up by the RBI in October 2010, chaired by Y.H. Malegam.
 
• The committee sets guidelines to ensure the sector's stability and growth while protecting borrowers' interests.
 
• Imposed a cap on the interest rate MFIs could charge, suggesting an average cost of funds plus a margin cap of 10-12%.
 
• Suggested that MFIs should lend only to families with an annual income of up to INR 60,000 in rural areas and INR 1,20,000 in urban areas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **R. V. Gupta Committee **was established in the late 1990s by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) to examine.
 
• The committee provide recommendations on issues related to** rural credit and microfinance.**
 
• The committee was chaired by** R. V. Gupta, a former Deputy Governor of the RBI.**
 
• Key recommendations of committee are: 
 
 
• ​Promotion of **Self-Help Groups (SHGs) **as a means to improve financial inclusion.
 
• Simplification of the procedures and documentation required for obtaining rural credit.
 
• Strengthening the role of the **National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD)**.
 
• Enhanced monitoring and supervision of rural branches and credit institutions.
 
 
 
• The **Parthasarathi Shome Committee, **also formally known as **the Committee on Tax Administration Reforms Commission (TARC), **was constituted by the Government of India.
 
• It was constituted to suggest **measures to reform the country's tax administration system.**
 
• key recommendations are: 
 
 
• ​Recommendations to **simplify tax procedures and enforcement to increase taxpayer compliance **and reduce evasion.
 
• Enhancing the services provided to taxpayers to make the process **more transparent and taxpayer-friendly.**
 
• Greater **use of information technology in tax administration **to streamline processes and improve data management.
 
• Providing a framework for the smooth implementation of the **Goods and Services Tax (GST).**
 
 

b6
